data.title: FK Jablonec vs Lugano Preview 11/26/2026 | Forebet
data.content: Jablonec remain without Jan Hanuš in their UEFA squad, with Michal Kukučka added and Klemen Mihelak expected to continue in goal. Kevin-Prince Milla remains a long-term absentee, while several players used earlier in qualifying are not on the current European list. Saidou Alioum’s goal at Artis Brno strengthens his case, but Kozel still has decisions to make between Alioum, Garang Kuol, Antonín Růsek and Lamin Jawo in attack. [...] Lugano are without Hannes Delcroix from the European squad after Joel Bichsel replaced him on the list. Ajeti is serving a reduced domestic ban, but that does not apply here, so he is available for Thursday. Ajeti’s European availability is a major boost, while Behrens offers another high-output option from the bench or alongside him. [...] Lugano probable XI: David von Ballmoos; Antonios Papadopoulos, Lukas Mai, Martim Marques; Bekhruz Karimov, Anto Grgic, Uran Bislimi, Daniel Dos Santos, Yanis Cimignani; Albian Ajeti, Kevin Behrens.
